# motionwind-vue v2.0.0 — machine reference

Stable Vue 3/Nuxt adapter backed by motion-v and motionwind-core.

Install:
npm install motionwind-vue@2 motion-v @vueuse/core motionwind-core@2

Vue/Vite static setup:
```ts
import vue from "@vitejs/plugin-vue";
import { createMotionwindTransform } from "motionwind-vue/vite";

vue({
  template: {
    compilerOptions: {
      nodeTransforms: [createMotionwindTransform(config)],
    },
  },
});

createApp(App).use(MotionwindPlugin, config).mount("#app");
```

Only native elements with static class attributes are transformed. Use the
runtime component for dynamic :class and for the tested Nuxt integration:
```vue
<Motionwind as="button" class="animate-hover:scale-105 animate-tap:scale-95">
  Save
</Motionwind>
```

Public runtime APIs: Motionwind, mw, useMotionwind, MotionwindPlugin,
parseMotionClasses, defineConfig, definePreset, defineMotionwindPlugin,
vueAdapter, and VUE_CAPABILITIES.

Motion for Vue naming is adapted automatically: shared whileTap becomes
whilePress and viewport options become inViewOptions.

Supported: gestures, in-view, initial/enter/exit data, transitions, drag,
layout, variants, SVG, and system reduced-motion handling. Exit behavior still
depends on Motion for Vue lifecycle orchestration.

Not supported: continuous animate-scroll:* mapping. The adapter warns and the
application must use Motion for Vue scroll composables directly.

Unsupported features must never be presented as silently working.
